dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: This tablet was erected by Mountain Shaper. It names Azhdaha as a terrible dragon, and serves as a warning for later generations to stay away from this place... from the seal.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It's a shame... There is a fine line between good and evil. If the good and evil within him could be summarized in a single sentence... well, never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (You gaze quietly at Zhongli as he stands beneath the tree...)

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli says nothing more...
dialogues.text: (Amidst the quiet, only the soft sound of the wind can be heard. Time seems to transform into an invisible river, trickling away...)

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli says nothing more...
dialogues.text: (A fleeting moment, a thousand years in the mortal world. The rocks feel it, and so too does the earth and the gods.)
